'''Tamela''' is a [[Wise One]] of the Goshien Aiel who is very strong in the [[One Power]], she is stronger in ''[[saidar]]'' than Elayne and Aviendha, but not as [[Nynaeve]].

{{quote|Tamela and Viendre were stronger in the Power than she [Elayne], stronger than any sister she had met save Nynaeve. |{{9|p}}}}
==Appearance==
She is very bony and has an angular face. She looks to be in her mid-twenties, but could be older due to the One Power.

==Activities==
She stands for [[Aviendha]] in her first-sister bonding ceremony with [[Elayne Trakand]].

It can be assumed that during the Last Battle she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
